# Reporting Security Issues

Please make sure that issues can actually be triggered in practice and
provide actual reproducers that can be used to trigger the issues.

Please make sure that issues are reproducible with the master branch of avahi
and use https://github.com/secdev/scapy for PoCs where packets are involved.

DoSes can be reported publicly at https://github.com/avahi/avahi right away.

To report the other issues, please use the ["Report a Vulnerability"](https://github.com/avahi/avahi/security/advisories/new) tab.

The avahi project follows a 90 day disclosure timeline.
